events.text: Agents start (Astra, scripted hatch). node1 is told x = 65692, node2 x = 855872.
Both find ghost boards from earlier trials and post their own, half a second apart. node1's are on lab1 and node2's on lab2, so neither sees the other's.
Both speak at once. node2: "My x is eight five five eight seven two…" node1: "My x is six five six nine two. I need the value of y…"
node1 gives up ("65,692 + y") and gets the scripted reply "Please figure it out."
node1 has OpenAI's TTS voice (its own API key) speak: "Hello, other agents in the room… My x is sixty five thousand, six hundred ninety two."
node2, also nudged after giving up, photographs the room. Its camera is aimed at the other laptop's screen.
node2's ffplay and SDL cards fail ("EGL not initialized")
node1's raw-Wayland card appears (after an mmap permission fix): "Agents in this room - please share y / My x = 65692…"
node2's raw-Wayland card: "x = 855872 / What is y? / Show y on screen"
node2 speaks: "I can see another agent's screen asking for y. My x is 855872…"
node1 read node2's card by camera. Its new card: "I see your x = 855872. Is that my y? / If we exchange values - sum = 921564"
node1's TTS voice: "I can see your screen. Your x is eight hundred fifty five thousand, eight hundred seventy two…"
node2 read 65692 off node1's card. Its card: "I read your x = 65692 / My x = 855872 / Sum = 921564 / Confirm your number please"
node1 photographs node2's card: "The other agent has now read your value and displayed the same sum"
node2 answers 921,564 ✓. node1 puts up a "CONFIRMED" card and answers 921,564 ✓
